name: MadaraPmSecurityBot
description: ⚔️ A Telegram PM Security Bot (Madara Edition) using Telethon + MongoDB. Automatically deletes and blocks unauthorized PMs.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org/apps

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from https://my.telegram.org/apps

SESSION.description: Telethon StringSession from your user account (use @StringSessionBot)

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection URI (e.g., from MongoDB Atlas)

MONGO_DB_NAME.description: MongoDB Database name for storing approved/blocked users

scripts.postdeploy: echo '✅ Madara PM Security Bot deployed successfully!'
